title: Sound hunt
offscreen: It's the classic sound game: "I spy something that starts with mmm". Say the sound, not the name of the letter.

items.label: Starts with mmm
items.say: Look for something that starts with mmm, like moon.

items.label: Starts with sss
items.say: Now something that starts with sss, like sun.

items.label: Starts with p
items.say: And something that starts with p, like pear.

items.label: Starts with lll
items.say: Look for something that starts with lll, like lamp.

items.label: Starts with t
items.say: Now something that starts with t, like table.

items.label: Starts with fff
items.say: And something that starts with fff, like fish.

intro.bo: {nome}, shall we go on a treasure hunt? You look in your own time, one thing at a time.
intro.pilu: {nome}, I'll tell you something to look for. Look carefully around you: treasures are everywhere.
intro.tango: Treasure hunt, {nome}! I'm coming too! ...No, I'll stay here. You look, slowly.

outro.bo: So many treasures, {nome}. Now each one goes back in its place, so we can find them again tomorrow.
outro.pilu: Every treasure goes back where you found it, {nome}: that's part of the game too.
outro.tango: What a hunt! {nome}, shall we put everything back? I'll... I'll keep an eye on it.
